Overhauls vanilla toast system to make it more alive and useful. Fancy Notify remakes old toasts from scratch and adds new notifications, that are focused on quality of life features, such weather notifications, biome notifications, and more!

Looking for the latest version? Check the main branch [`README.md`](https://github.com/Bivrik/FancyNotify/blob/master/README.md)
